name: hub-hero
description: Industry hub hero: headline with a gradient lead phrase, badges and a demo button over a dashboard backdrop with up to three cut-out photos, and a strip of three feature chips (a marquee on phones). Live: #ap-gov-hero on the government, healthcare, construction and manufacturing hubs.

title_accent.description: Part of the title painted with the brand gradient.

mobile_background.description: Composite image shown behind the phone layout.

photos.description: Up to three cut-out photos. Each: image, alt, x, y, w, h (% of the stage); optional ix, iy, iw, ih (% placement of the image inside its box, which then crops it).

veil_height.description: Height of the white fade at the foot of the stage, % of the stage.

content_top.description: Vertical centre of the copy column, % of the stage. 0 keeps the default placement.

features_band.description: Put the feature chips in a ruled band under the stage (the education hub) instead of over it.

features.description: Feature chips along the bottom. Each: label; icon (URL) or icon_svg.
